title: I Own These 4 Stocks. I Wouldn’t Buy Them Today
creator: Couch Investor
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions (manual English captions)
summary: Couch Investor walks through four holdings he owns but won't add to right now, plus a SoFi bonus, explaining what would change his mind on each. Netflix: he cut the position in half and is down 16% on the remainder; the business is healthy (operating margin near 30%) and undervalued at $71 in his view, but growth is decelerating (16% TTM toward ~10% expected in FY28) and as a growth investor he wants mid-teens growth before adding — HOLD (flip from SELL). Rubrik: up 60.7% YTD to a $25B valuation on $1.54B revenue; he took profits as forward P/E ~250x and PEG ~12 mean it's 'priced to perfection' — only re-buys on a pullback or faster profitability — HOLD (flip from SELL). Reddit: a small starter position, DCF-undervalued with improving margins and doubling ARPU, but he's waiting for the next earnings and an AI data-licensing deal catalyst — HOLD (flip from BUY). AMD: trimmed 25–30% after a 184% run; growth still underestimated but valuation stretched, so marginal capital goes to NVDA/AVGO — HOLD (no flip). SoFi (bonus): still extremely bullish with a big position, but not adding until macro improves (2027 rate-hike expectations) — HOLD (flip from BUY). He also notes he's battling a bacterial infection, so fewer videos near-term.
